findings.title: Agent  field overrides the key and can make a subagent session display a primary agent
findings.rationale: If a subagent definition (frontmatter or opencode.json) includes , Agent.merge overwrites the runtime name. TaskTool uses agent.name for the subagent session, while the task UI shows params.subagent_type. This yields exactly the mismatch described: parent task says the subagent name, but the subagent session displays the overridden (primary) agent.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove/align the  field in subagent configs, or change TaskTool to use params.subagent_type as the session agent name instead of agent.name.
